answers.question: Which tracks/platforms are in use after the rebuild?
answers.answer: Six tracks with platforms, all 350 m: from 30 Aug 2025 'Drammen stasjon er ombygget til 6 spor med plattform'; new/changed platforms on tracks 1-6. Bane NOR's track table: track 1 side platform (760 mm), island platform tracks 2/3 (760/740 mm), island platform tracks 4/5 (760/755 mm), track 6 side platform (760/735 mm), all 3.5 m wide (as tabled). Entur NSR has rail quays 1-6. OSM maps only platform 1 and island 2;3; platforms 4/5 and 6 are missing in OSM.
answers._source: Bane NOR S-sirkulære 121-2025 'Drammenbanen, Drammen stasjon: endringer i infrastruktur' (25 Aug 2025, valid from 30 Aug 2025), https://orv.banenor.no/contentassets/6b86820bcb5442988c81c41521311f27/s-sirkulare-121-2025.pdf, read 2026-10-30; Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-d-/drammen/, read 2026-10-30; Entur NSR stop register, NSR:StopPlace:59952 children (rail NSR:StopPlace:11, bus NSR:StopPlace:21), https://api.entur.io/stop-places/v1/read/stop-places/NSR:StopPlace:59952/children, read 2026-10-30 (NLOD); Regjeringen.no, speech at the opening of InterCity Drammen-Kobbervikdalen, https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/tale-pa-arrangement-i-anledning-apning-av-intercity-prosjektet-drammen-kobbervikdalen/id3119576/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_no/NO-DRM.json), read 2026-10-30

answers.question: Which platforms have lifts?
answers.answer: Owner text confirms a lift from the station hall down to the underpass. OSM adds lifts from the underpass to platform 1 and to island 2/3, and one lift between street and Bybrua. No owner source names lifts for platforms 4/5 and 6, and OSM does not map those platforms. The government speech says the rebuilt station has universal design, which suggests step-free access to all platforms but does not say how.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-d-/drammen/, read 2026-10-30; Regjeringen.no, speech at the opening of InterCity Drammen-Kobbervikdalen, https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/tale-pa-arrangement-i-anledning-apning-av-intercity-prosjektet-drammen-kobbervikdalen/id3119576/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_no/NO-DRM.json), read 2026-10-30

open: Lifts, stairs and ramps to platforms 4/5 and 6: OSM has neither these platforms nor links to them; Bane NOR's accessibility text ('stairs and steep ramps to the island platforms') looks older than the Aug 2025 rebuild. No as-built plan found.

Bybrua: trade press says it gives access down to all platforms; OSM maps stairs to 1 and 2/3 plus two stairs (w1444726162, w1444726165) to unmapped platforms. Whether there are lifts from Bybrua to the platforms is not stated anywhere.
Narvesen Drammen jbst. hours: narvesen.no loads hours by script; not in OSM.
Joker hours are OSM-only (joker.no store finder did not render).
Signposted level names, floor heights: no source.
Parking counts differ between Bane NOR's Norwegian and English pages (dagparkering 55 vs 26; pendler 227 vs 302); Norwegian figures used.
English page lists 'ATM' among facilities; Norwegian page does not; OSM has no ATM in the building. Left out.
Faseplan PDF (2023-2025) could not be opened (banenor.no not reachable with WebFetch).
OSM lists nearby places outside the station building (Baker Hansen St. Hallvard, Champs Grill og Pizza, Strømsø Sportspub etc.); not added as station amenities.
